description.value: Dead Frog Brewery & Tasting Room is a Langley-based craft brewery that has been producing small-batch, preservative-free beers for over 10 years, with the beer brewed just 50 feet from the taps. The dog-friendly patio, rotating creative tap list, and regular events like live music Sundays and family-friendly 'Taps & Tots' mornings give it a lively, community feel. Located in the heart of the Fraser Valley, it offers fresh food alongside an ever-changing lineup of sours, IPAs, stouts, and lagers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at deadfrog.ca is fully accessible and provides address (#105-8860 201 St, Langley BC), phone (604-856-1055), and amenity details. The contact page explicitly lists 'Free Wifi,' 'Limited Free Parking,' 'Patio,' and 'Dog-Friendly,' and the event pages confirm to-go beer sales. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the site. OSM name 'Dead Frog Tasting Room' differs from the website name 'Dead Frog Brewery & Tasting Room.'
concerns: OSM name is 'Dead Frog Tasting Room' but the website consistently uses 'Dead Frog Brewery' or 'Dead Frog Brewery & Tasting Room' — OSM name may be incomplete.
OSM had no address or phone; both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed for phone and address is null.
Postal code appears as 'V2Y OC8' on contact page (letter O) but event subpages show 'V2Y 0C8' (zero) — likely a typo on the contact page; zero version used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft brewery tasting room with food, patio, Wi-Fi, and to-go beer in Langley — a legitimate and useful stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley. Bike parking status should be confirmed on-site.
